label: C2 contingency grounding: power-grounded non-existence, receptivity and the First Way endpoint
summary: Follow-up to PR #1870 (gap 1, next test 3), God-existence stage of the root; note docs/notes/contingency-receptivity-c2.md; repaired after the independent semantic challenge of head 470f90b80. Target C2: every being contingent at w is existentially receptive (esse received in a principle in RECEPTIVE_POTENCY_1 to it, or matter and form) or has a distinct SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 CAUSE_2 of its esse. Checked: C2 from PGP (contingent beings can fail to be in substance, the in-subject channel, or are under some being's broad power over their esse, POWER_OVER_ESSE_1), correlation (a co-occurrence disjunction: if y has such power, x can fail to be in substance or y is a CAUSE_2 of x's esse), passive-to-receptive, b62a64ab and B3, constructively; unreceivedness of the First Way's mover from simplicity, R3, De ente and receptive irreflexivity, constructively; the First Way's mover necessary (endpoint f9208664) from firstness, unreceivedness and C2 with excluded middle, POTENCY_1 pure act carried and unused; C2 from R1 with De ente and from B2 with B3; C2, its weak form and the certified difference (strength comparison 07689384, separator unprioritized); B2 or B4 (3c9d683b) from PGP, correlation, b62a64ab and corruptible-has-POTENCY_1. New disambiguations: f5dda05f (POWER_OVER_ESSE: broad versus giving power) and d25cee67 (POSSIBLE_NOT_TO_BE: in the subject versus through another's power; under it Aquinas denies #1870's B4a for angels). Findings: correlation yields #1870 bridge (ii) only for incorruptibles; the unrestricted form is not derived and its countermodel is an uncaused corruptible composite; B4b with adopted POTENCY_1 excludes actual corruptibles (law 10); correlation is trivial under the giving sense (law 11); C2 and B2 or B4 are independent; PGP and C2 are independent of the pure-act target; the angelic model's B4 and target failures are structural only. Provisional judgment: C2 is not contested by the recorded rivals on any corruptible or dependent being, given passive-to-receptive and B3 (both OPEN); its contested scope is exactly the foundational simple being where the route applies it, so the route's force there equals that of power-grounded modality for existence, a serious theory not shown superior here to combinatorial, primitivist, existence-conditional essentialist or hybrid rivals. Ordinary cases and the explicit case analysis do not discriminate; no substantive objection shows C2 false.
blocker: No premise is established; B2 or B4 3c9d683b is now derived (proved, not established), its leaf replaced by four new bare premises: PGP 20d5fecd, correlation 9163c423, passive-to-receptive 16c760a3, corruptible-has-POTENCY_1 8bfc4ab7. Standing rival: a contingent, simple, unreceived, uncaused first actuality on a hybrid view (act and potency for change, non-power modality for existence), priced at de re possibility of absence with no internal or external modal ground. The B2, B6 and PGP routes face correlated denials from one Humean or primitivist package. Next tests: (1) matching-scope comparison of modal theories for existence; (2) tensed conserving strengthening of correlation via c94eed5b (the deist question); (3) passive-to-receptive for a corruptible without matter; (4) corruptible-has-POTENCY_1; (5) C1 connection bridges (no actual esse-cause to firstness; CCR root to unreceivedness) and q.3 a.7.
